summary: No migration defects in the scored output (all 3 scenarios pass). The only friction was a recoverable build failure: MediaElement does not exist in WinUI 3 and its code-behind API surface (SetSource/GetAsCastingSource) is not 1:1 with MediaPlayerElement. The skill lists the XAML type swap but its note understates the code-behind delegation — a generalizable clarity/correctness gap.
